```mermaid
flowchart TD
  %% rich flowchart features (no interactivity)
  subgraph S1[Subsystem]
    direction LR
    A([Start]) --> B{Decision}
    B -->|Yes| C[Do thing]
    B -->|No| D[Do other]
  end
  C --> E([End])
  D --> E
  classDef good fill:#d3f9d8,stroke:#2f9e44,stroke-width:2px;
  classDef bad fill:#ffe3e3,stroke:#c92a2a,stroke-width:2px;
  class C good;
  class D bad;
  linkStyle 0 stroke:#1c7ed6,stroke-width:2px;
```
